title: 快时尚利润率承压：Shein，如何突围？
speaker: Su Trita Codali

segments.en: Su Trita, this is David. Apologies in advance. It's a bit noisy. I'm joining here from the field.
segments.zh: Su Trita，我是David。提前道歉，这里有点吵，我在现场连线。

segments.en: So my question is it's fast fashion. It's fast growing. But there's a lot of competition.
segments.zh: 我的问题是，快时尚增长很快，但竞争也非常激烈。

segments.en: It's not exactly a margin business. The help is understand what the trajectory of the company
segments.zh: 这并非高利润业务。请帮助理解公司未来的发展轨迹

segments.en: looks like from the perspective of it being able to expand its margins moving forward. And we might
segments.zh: 尤其是在未来能否扩大利润率方面。我们或许需要

segments.en: re-think this multiple right now that markets are currently attaching to the stock that's down.
segments.zh: 重新审视当前市场给予这家下跌公司的估值倍数。
